extra.summary: The OCBC INFINITY Cashback Card offers a flat 1.6% cashback on all spending, excelling in its simplicity and lack of spending tiers or cashback caps. This makes it well-suited for those seeking predictable, fuss-free rewards, especially since there's no minimum spend required.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Supplementary Annual Fee: S$98.10 a year (waived for the first year)

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
•At least S$30,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged between 21 and 54
•At least S$15,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged 55 and above

our_takes.our-take: The OCBC INFINITY Cashback Card offers a flat 1.6% cashback on all spending, excelling in its simplicity and lack of spending tiers or cashback caps. This makes it well-suited for those seeking predictable, fuss-free rewards, especially since there's no minimum spend required. However, the 1.6% rate might not be optimal for those who concentrate their spending in specific categories like dining or groceries, as competing cards offer higher rates in those areas. Also, take note of the exclusions, particularly transactions via payment platforms like GrabPay or YouTrip, which don't earn cashback.
our_takes.good-for:
Those who want fuss-free cashback on all spending, without tracking categories or minimum spends.
Cardholders looking for generous cashback on daily essentials and online purchases both locally and overseas.
Individuals who prefer simplicity with unlimited cashback and appreciate automatic crediting to their card account each month.
our_takes.things-to-note:
S$196.20 annual fee applies after the first year, so evaluate if the cashback earned justifies the cost.
Late payment fee is S$100, so set reminders and make payments on time to avoid unnecessary charges.
Cashback isn't earned on payments to EZ-Link, NETS FlashPay, GrabPay, and more, limiting earning potential.
